pages.text: Another player can shear white wool from you. Costs 1 shears durability. Cooldown: 15 seconds. Meaty and Wooly can both activate on one use.
pages.title: Wooly

pages.text: $(bold)Mob sources$()$(br)Sheep.$(br2)Collect their organic matter, then analyze, extract, decode, and infuse the gene. Server configuration can disable individual genes.
